messages:
mara: FYI prod-eu warm pool stalled this morning after fw baseline change. New nodes stayed Pending with KMS errors.
ops-bot: deploy: firewall/eu-tighten rolled by sol at 2026-03-29T22:35Z (change-id ch_20260329_fw_eu_tight3) :warning:
mara: node-init logs: ```2026-03-29T22:41:09Z keystore: decrypt failed: AccessDenied: "KMSGrantNotAuthorized"
trace: node-init -> keystore-proxy -> privatelink-eu -> kms-eu```
devin: That tighten reduced egress to management CIDRs and removed broad NAT egress for ephemeral. Looks like keystore privatelink IPs were not included.
sol: We removed a /24 allow in favor of mgmt /28s to reduce telemetry. Missed the keystore privatelink 10.4.16.0/28 range.
nisha: Immediate mitigations: (A) add temporary fw allow for 10.4.16.0/28 to keystore port 443 with TTL, (B) re-enable NAT for ephem tag, (C) failover provisioning to usw2. Prefer (A).
security-bot: Exception requirements: justification + owner, TTL <= 4h, audit tag, KMS grant log export attached, notify compliance channel.
mara: I'll take owner. Action: apply allow for 10.4.16.0/28 -> 10.4.16.5:443, TTL 2h, tag=keystore-emerg-20260329. Creating ticket.
ops-bot: policy-exception #4128 created by mara (expires 2026-03-29T24:41Z).
infra-ci: alert suppressed for warm_nodes while exception active.
devin: Quick checks from bastion: ```curl -sSf https://keystore-eu.privatelink.redwood.internal/health -> 200 OK
# still saw KMS grant access denied prior to fw change```
sol: Rolled exception. New nodes showing keystore.decrypt ok in logs: ```keystore: decrypt ok key=arn:aws:kms:eu:123456:key/abcd-ef01```
mara: monitoring added: keystore.decrypt_ratio{region="eu"} and gpu.pool.warm_missing. Alert if decrypt_ratio < 0.9 for 2m or warm_missing > 0.
security-bot: Reminder: attach KMS audit logs (grant id + principal) and fw change id to incident record. Compliance will require the TTL reasoning.
devin: Tradeoffs to document: 1) Loosen egress (NAT cost ~ $250/mo) 2) Per-service privatelink endpoints (~$650/mo/region + ops) 3) CI firewall test + canary (dev hours ~2-4, low recurring cost).
nisha: I'll draft a short options memo and cost calc. Recommend CI test + canary now, and evaluate endpoint in next quarter if exceptions occur again.
mara: Postmortem owner: @mara. Runtime fix owner: @devin. Security sign-off: @sol.
security-bot: After-action: run compliance scan on all recent fw changes and flag any that removed privatelink ranges.
mara: Thanks everyone. Will post PM with KMS grant logs and link to runbook: https://runbooks.redwoodinfra/internal/keystore-egress-eu. :thumbsup:
